findings_C107.kernel_leak: NONE: tracemalloc snapshot diff across 30 further evolve() calls at ~400 rows shows +9/-8 KB churn, no growth
findings_C107.traced_memory_growth: the soak's OWN locals (rows / committed of the growing archive): 66 MB for 7191 rows = ~9 KB per row in memory vs 0.93 KB on disk (player manifests ~0.9 KB of JSON each, x10 Python object overhead). A 100k-row archive would need ~1 GB to resume from: rows should carry player_hash + receipt id and fetch manifests on demand (design note, not built)
findings_C107.wall_drift: 0.82 -> 1.41 s per soak iteration; mostly the soak's instrument: each iteration reloads the whole archive (load_rows 0.12 s at 7191 rows, linear) and runs under tracemalloc whose cost grows with traced blocks. A resumed generation at 7191 rows costs 0.44 s without tracemalloc: execute 0.26 s, load_rows 0.12 s
findings_C107.waste_found: host_block() ran platform.platform() (a WMI query on Windows) per receipt: 77 ms of a 443 ms generation (17%). Cached per process (C107), like build_block (C56)
